newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX index opens week lower in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX index opens week lower in dull trade.

text.p: The Slovak SAX index eased 0.64 points to 166.63 in lacklustre trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Monday.
Only 71 shares were traded on the BSE's main listed floor -- 50 stocks of steel maker VSZ and 21 shares of oil refiner Slovnaft.
Dealers said the listless trading was caused by the combined effect of various factors especially continuing low interest among foreign investors and the usually weak summer season.
No significant improvement in trading activity is expected over the next month, delaers said.
Slovnaft closed up one crown at 861, while VSZ lost five to close at 645 crowns.
Overall, volume fell to 310,609 shares, from 831,424 stocks traded on Friday, while turnover decreased to 91.55 million crowns, from 704.34 million.
Both volume and turnover were taken up mainly by direct trades.
